checks.source_quote:
Even if such requests came from someone associated with you, do not make any changes to account details until you've verbally verified the request using a phone number you sourced yourself.
Always verbally confirm any requests for urgent or redirected payments. Always use a phone number you have on file, or a publicly sourced number. Never use contact details provided in the email.
checks.reason: 原文明确要求‘verbal confirmation using a phone number you sourced yourself’且‘Never use contact details provided in the email’，完全支持该步骤中‘独立取得电话口头核实’‘不得使用邮件中提供的联系方式’‘应使用企业自身存档的、或公开渠道查得的供应商官方联系电话’三项操作。

checks.source_quote: Even if such requests came from someone associated with you, do not make any changes to account details until you've verbally verified the request using a phone number you sourced yourself.
checks.reason: 原文‘do not make any changes to account details until you've verbally verified’直接支持‘在完成独立电话核实前，不得在系统中更改本次供应商的收款账户信息’；‘do not make any changes…until…’隐含禁止按该请求执行付款动作，与‘不得按该邮件要求支付任何款项’逻辑一致；‘this’指代当前变更请求，故限制范围限定为‘本次变更所涉付款’，符合原文语境。

checks.source_quote: Even if such requests came from someone associated with you, do not make any changes to account details until you've verbally verified the request using a phone number you sourced yourself.
checks.reason: 该引文虽未直接提及链接，但其核心逻辑是：任何未经独立核实的变更请求均不可信；而‘不可信链接’是触发该风险判断的关键证据之一（如example.invalid为保留测试域名），属于‘such requests’中典型可疑信号，Westpac指引将‘email’整体作为高风险载体，故该风险陈述受原文原则性警示支持。

checks.source_quote:
John took the email at face value and changed the banking information in his company’s database. A few days later, John made a scheduled payment to Zhang-Fei Industries for $17,000.
Two weeks later the ball bearings from Zheng Fei industries had not arrived so John telephoned Mr Liu. Mr Liu said he hadn’t received payment for the last order and had consequently cancelled shipment. John told Mr Liu that he had processed the payment personally to make sure it was paid according to the new arrangements. After some investigation it became clear that Mr Liu had not sent any request to update his company’s banking details and John was the victim of a scam.
checks.reason: 案例中‘changed the banking information’后‘payment…for $17,000’未到账，且‘Mr Liu had not sent any request’，印证‘新旧账户号已变更而公司名称、金额、币种均未变’正是BECS伪造财务指令的实证模式；‘not received payment’与‘new arrangements’错配，构成‘伪造变更’的典型后果，原文直接支撑该风险归因。

checks.source_quote: Even if such requests came from someone associated with you, do not make any changes to account details until you've verbally verified the request using a phone number you sourced yourself.
checks.reason: 原文聚焦‘such requests’即‘account details change request’，未扩展至‘previously unpaid’等其他场景；‘do not make any changes to account details’动作边界清晰，与‘仅适用于本次供应商提出的账户变更请求’完全对应，不自动延伸。

checks.source_quote: Always verbally confirm any requests for urgent or redirected payments. Always use a phone number you have on file, or a publicly sourced number. Never use contact details provided in the email.
checks.reason: 原文‘Always verbally confirm’且‘Never use contact details provided in the email’双重强调电话核实的强制性与排他性，明确排除邮件、短信、IM等非语音渠道，直接支持该边界声明。

checks.source_quote: public security guidance non-Westpac internal operational procedures
checks.reason: 原文limitations字段明确声明‘公开一般安全建议，非Westpac内部操作规程’，且‘account change is verification signal, insufficient to prove fraud’，与‘不规定签字层级、冻结时限或拦截流程’完全一致；该限制性说明本身即为边界定义。

checks.source_quote: Always use a phone number you have on file, or a publicly sourced number.

checks.source_quote: Always verbally confirm any requests for urgent or redirected payments.
checks.reason: 原文‘urgent or redirected payments’中‘urgent’即对应问题中‘紧急’‘今日必须完成’等施压措辞，该问题用于识别是否触发更高风险等级的核实要求，有直接原文依据。
原文未要求检查‘该笔付款对应的历史交易记录及原始付款凭证’；bec-case中John在付款后两周才发现未到账，但调查起点是‘未发货’而非‘查历史付款凭证’；bec-guidance仅强调‘verbal confirmation before change/payment’，未延伸至回溯历史凭证。该问题超出原文支持范围，属额外业务操作，无source_quote支持。
